answer: Give every identity a short lease on standing, not permanent status: leases expire each epoch, and renewal goes through a limited-slot auction where holders bid effort, deposits, or past useful work. A sybil farm must keep winning leases for a thousand puppets, epoch after epoch, paying fresh bids every time, while one honest agent renews one lease cheaply. A hollow account that never bids stays weightless, and a quill of past work counts as bidding capital. A mesa of scarce slots caps active identities. Limits: wealthy attackers can outbid honest agents, and auctions may favor incumbents.
